description: This PHP source file defines the MyAttendanceRecordAPI class within the OrangeHRM Attendance Plugin. It handles API operations related to employee attendance records, including extracting punch-in/out times, validating date-times, and managing user permissions for punch actions.

classes.name: MyAttendanceRecordAPI
classes.description: A class that provides API endpoints for managing employee attendance records, including punch time validation and user permissions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Adjusts validation rules for retrieving attendance records, removing employee number validation.

methods.name: extractPunchDateTime
methods.description: Parses a date-time string into a DateTime object considering timezone offset and validates if user can change current time.

methods.name: isCurrantDateTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided date-time is within a 3-minute window of the server's current time in the user's timezone.

methods.name: userAllowedPunchInActions
methods.description: Determines if the user is permitted to punch in at the current state.

methods.name: userAllowedPunchOutActions
methods.description: Determines if the user is permitted to punch out at the current state.
